capabilities.rationale: A narrow, offline PDF-to-CSV parser for one specific archived PRASA transition-agency report (ACT agency 163 'Contratos Vigentes'). It accepts only the stable pdftotext -layout shape of that one report and writes the existing pr_prasa_contracts.csv schema consumed by downstream pipeline steps; it does not claim general PRASA-PDF ingestion. Same category as build_source_drop_manifest.py: an offline evidence-acquisition script feeding existing pipeline outputs, not a separate interactive dashboard capability.
